title: NIGHT WATCH
BLESS THE LORD
end: The Secret Place — prayers every day

scenes.a: If you are lying awake wondering how tomorrow will unfold, rest your mind right now.
Behold, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, which by night stand in the house of the LORD.
scenes.sub: STAND BY NIGHT IN HIS HOUSE

scenes.a: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.
The LORD that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.
Lord, as midnight surrounds this bed, we lift our hands to You.
scenes.sub: WE LIFT OUR HANDS TO YOU

scenes.a: You made heaven and earth, yet You watch over this quiet room tonight.
Cover this heart with Your deep peace and grant sweet sleep. Subscribe to join us at The Secret Place for daily prayer.
